value.name: Asha receives affidavits and letter
value.description: Asha takes the signed affidavits and the letter, confirming their physical weight before holding them.
evidence: the two signed affidavits beneath, the embossed seal showing faintly through the cardigan-creased paper
Asha took them without speaking and laid her palm over the top sheet, holding it there a moment as if to confirm the weight

value.name: Lucia absorbs the moment in silence
value.description: Lucia exhales shakily, leans back, and stares ahead without looking again at the papers or speaking.
evidence: Lucia let out a long, uneven breath and leaned her head back against the headrest, her eyes fixed on nothing through the beaded windshield
She did not look at the pages again

value.name: Rosa watches and settles herself
value.description: Rosa watches Lucia briefly, then faces forward and places her hands on her knees as time passes.
evidence: Rosa watched her a moment longer, then turned her face forward and put her hands flat on her knees
and the dashboard clock ticked over another minute

value.name: Asha secures documents in briefcase
value.description: Asha places the papers and letter into her briefcase, locks it, and sets it across her knees.
evidence: Asha laid the stack into her briefcase with the letter still on top, clicked the locks down one after the other, and set the case flat across her knees

value.name: Lucia exits car reluctantly
value.description: Lucia struggles with the door, pauses with her hand on the handle, then steps out onto the curb without looking back.
evidence: On Lucia's side the handle clicked but did not move; she sat a moment longer with her fingers curled around it
then pushed the door open and stepped down onto the curb without looking back at the house they had left

value.name: Rosa exits car quietly
value.description: Rosa gets out on her side and closes the door gently behind her.
evidence: Rosa came out on her own side in the same breath, shoes finding the wet pavement with a flat sound, and shut the door behind her without slamming it

value.name: Asha guides Lucia toward attorney's office
value.description: Asha comes around the car, takes Lucia by the elbow, and leads her toward the attorney's vestibule with the briefcase held close.
evidence: Asha came around the hood with the briefcase pressed close against her ribcoat, took Lucia lightly at the elbow, and started them toward the lit glass of the attorney's vestibule
